title: Is the U.S. Legal System Ready for AI’s Challenges to Human Values?

bias_targets.methodology: Legal analysis of a simulated hypothetical scenario (Scenario 1: Educational Disparity) to evaluate potential legal recourse under the Fourteenth Amendment regarding unequal access to advanced AI educational tools between wealthy and lower-income school districts.

Legal evaluation of a simulated hypothetical scenario (Scenario 2: Manipulation/Discrimination) to assess the viability of civil rights, defamation, and product liability claims against an AI developer whose tool fosters anti-LGBTQIA+ sentiment.
